title: Royalty Pool Accounting
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Royalty Pool Accounting.
learning_objectives: Explain royalty pool accounting using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for royalty pool accounting
Assess failure and operational limits of royalty pool accounting
concepts_covered: A royalty pool is a balance ledger: payments accumulate and an eligible creator later claims the amount.
payRoyalty transfers configured ERC20 into a token-specific pool; claimRoyalties checks original creator and transfers the claim.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
